visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman jumps into view from behind a dark wood-paneled wall, wearing a large, stiff four-pointed star costume in shades of pink, white, and blue. She is smiling broadly, her face appearing through a central opening in the fabric. The background reveals a modern, brightly lit interior with a kitchen island cluttered with various boxes and shopping bags. (2) She moves playfully in the costume, performing a small dance while looking directly at the camera. She wears black leggings and brown open-toed sandals. The camera maintains a medium-shot distance, capturing her full body and the domestic setting. (3) In a series of cuts, she hides behind the wall again and repeatedly peeks out or runs back into the living space, continuing to laugh and adjust her position. The kitchen area remains static with white cabinetry and a marble-topped island in the background. (4) The woman turns her back to the camera, showing the flat side of the star costume, then turns back to laugh at the viewer. Yellow subtitles appear at the bottom center of the screen throughout these movements.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-tempo disco-pop music (YMCA) starts immediately with a strong 4/4 beat. A loud burst of high-pitched female laughter is heard. The BGM has clear brass and percussion elements. (2) A sharp rustling sound occurs as the person in the star costume moves rapidly. The laughing continues with high arousal, overlapping the music. (3) A female voice shouts '不要笑' (Don't laugh) with a playful, rising pitch. A second female voice responds with more laughter, creating a cacophony of joyful noise. (4) Footsteps on a hard floor surface are faintly audible between laughs. The BGM maintains a steady energy level without pauses. (5) The laughter reaches a peak intensity towards the end, with the main speaker gasping for air between giggles while the disco track continues to play at full volume.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Multiple comedic attempts -> Climax
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To entertain viewers by showcasing a humorous and 'ugly' Halloween costume. The video relies on the absurdity of the star-shaped outfit and the genuine laughter shared between friends to create a lighthearted, relatable social media moment.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video features a popular internet meme costume (a star-shaped garment often associated with 'Primogems' from the game Genshin Impact). The high arousal and valence in the audio contribute significantly to the comedic impact.
